name: Sidebar
description:
The Sidebar surface. Composed from the Card family (surface) and
Stack (spacer layout); appearance is token- and class-driven through
`styles.module.scss` (all `var(--phi-*)` tokens, no inline style, no
hardcoded colors).

Any additional DOM attributes (e.g. `data-collapsed`, `data-variant`) are
forwarded to the Card root element, so compositions such as
SidebarBrand can express collapse/variant state as data attributes on
the sidebar root without introducing raw layout wrappers.
